description: The plan sees the real free space, min_free and what already holds a path. With 1000 bytes, 800 used and 5 % kept: 200 are free, of which 150 can be filled, so one file of 100 fits and a second does not, though it would fit in what is free. A folder on the target blocks a file of its name, and 800 bytes find no room on the other disk.
config:
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]
mount = "${SANDBOX}/pool"
[[disk]]
id = "t1"
uuid = "3f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1"
fs = "ext4"
[[disk]]
id = "t2"
uuid = "7a2b4c6d-8e0f-4a1b-9c2d-3e4f5a6b7c8d"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t2"
fs = "ext4"

steps.query: SELECT CAST(lpath AS TEXT), state FROM files ORDER BY lpath
SELECT id, capacity_bytes, free_bytes FROM disks ORDER BY position
